name: iges_solids
why: IGES is needed when on the other side there is a CAD or a machine that does not read STEP. With the «solids» representation (BREP) the volume must survive the translation as in STEP -- and it is measured by reopening the file, not by looking at how much it weighs.
_why_the_records: an IGES is made of lines of eighty characters, and column 73 says which section they belong to: S start, G global, D directory, P parameters, T terminate. A file with only the headers and nothing inside exists, weighs and opens: it is caught by counting the «P» records.

expect.tolerance_why: the volume of the translated geometry, read from GetMassProperties which returns cubic metres
